lessons.title: Why Publishing Volume Without Strategy Fails

blocks.text: Strategic Alignment & Business Goals

Content strategy sits upstream of writing: it defines WHO we serve, WHAT problem we own uniquely in the market, WHICH funnel stages currently leak, and WHAT commercial or mission metric content must shift (`qualified trials`, `onboarding completion`, `support deflection`). Without that north star, teams celebrate empty pageviews while growth stalls.
Planning, structuring, governing, and maintaining editorial assets across the user journey so every published piece serves an explicit audience need and organizational outcome.

blocks.body: If churn spikes at Day 7 onboarding, content strategy prioritizes interactive activation checklists and customer use-case walkthroughs—NOT generic top-of-funnel trends.

Say no deliberately to trendy broad subjects outside your product’s core sweet spot.

lessons.title: Concrete Sensory Grounding

blocks.text: Show Through Behavior & Detail

Telling declares an emotion ("Tom was angry"); showing places the reader inside the room as Tom squeezes a paper cup until coffee beads across his knuckles. Grounding scenes in two or three carefully chosen sensory cues (sound, tactile texture, light) creates immediate immersion without burying action in purple adjectives.
Rendering a pivotal story moment in real-time action, dialogue, and sensory detail rather than compressing it into summary narration.

blocks.text: Goal-Driven Characterization

blocks.text: Minimum Viable CRM Design

lessons.title: Punctuation Precision: Hyphens, Dashes & Quotes

blocks.text: Compound Modifiers & Dash Discipline
